CPM.cmake.role: CMake script included unconditionally by bit7z's cmake/Dependencies.cmake; hash pinned by bit7z; no package is fetched through it

sanitizer_exception: SevenZip performs unaligned integer loads on the valid ZIP control, so the fuzzer disables only UBSan's alignment check. The AFL++ overlay also disables UBSan's function-type check for AFL's compiler wrapper. bit7z and SevenZip both define COM GUID constants, so ASan's duplicate-global ODR check is disabled at load; ASan memory checks and other UBSan checks remain enabled.
coverage: LLVM source coverage in the static bit7z 4.1.0 library reached through Bit7zLibrary(path), BitArchiveReader(Bit7zLibrary, local path, BitFormat::Zip), itemsCount, itemAt and extractTo(buffer, index) on a temporary copy of the input, and in the SevenZip 26.04 Format7zF 7z.so (ZIP handler, ZIP reader, Deflate decoder) that bit7z loads; both are built from the pinned sources in the image
parser_family: SevenZip ZIP reader; bit7z is a distinct C++ wrapper API over the SevenZip 7z.so and is one parser family with SevenZip, not an independent ZIP decoder
